San Jacopino — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Piazza San Jacopino is explicitly named in the official Prefecture 'zona rossa' loitering-ban ordinance. This is one of the most consistently and repeatedly covered problem areas in Florence local press over the past two years: residents have organised multiple protests to the Prefecture describing themselves as 'under siege,' with recurring break-ins, drug dealing, street bivouacs and, more recently, gang score-settling ('regolamenti di conti fra gang'). Extraordinary joint police/carabinieri operations have been run specifically in this area. Sources checked: Controradio, Prefecture 'zone rosse' list including Piazza San Jacopino; La Nazione, 'Firenze, la rabbia di San Jacopino: Siamo assediati'; FirenzeToday, San Jacopino residents protest outside the Prefecture; OkFirenze, San Jacopino gang score-settling after drug dealing and break-ins.
